@@ -1,16 +0,0 @@
-[package]
-name = "trussbars-studio"
-description = "Trussbars Studio — a local IDE (filesystem-backed) for inspecting your Trussbars app. You build a tiny binary that registers your compiled helpers and calls `serve(...)`; it hosts an IDE over your template directory and inspects in-process (your data, your helpers). docs/10."
-version.workspace = true
-edition.workspace = true
-rust-version.workspace = true
-license.workspace = true
-keywords = ["template", "trussbars", "studio", "inspector"]
-categories = ["template-engine", "development-tools"]
-
-[dependencies]
-trussbars-vm = { path = "../trussbars-vm" }
-serde_json = "1"
-
-[lints]
-workspace = true
